healing_tonic.name: Healing Tonic
healing_tonic.description: A bitter red draught brewed by the Harrow herbalists. Restores 45 HP.

honey_bread.name: Honey Bread
honey_bread.description: Still warm from the Gilded Kettle's oven. Restores 20 HP.

sunpetal.name: Sunpetal
sunpetal.description: A golden flower that turns to follow the light. Herbalists prize it.

riverstone.name: Riverstone
riverstone.description: Smooth blue stone from the river Vael. Faintly cool to the touch.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.description: A mushroom that glows near old Aether currents.

echo_shard.name: Echo Shard
echo_shard.description: A sliver of Choir crystal. Held to the ear, it hums a single note of a forgotten song.

copper_coin.name: Copper Marks
copper_coin.description: Harrow Concord currency, stamped with the Old Span.

travelers_blade.name: Traveler's Blade
travelers_blade.description: The short single-edged blade you woke up holding. Its maker's mark is worn away.

lantern_charm.name: Lantern Charm
lantern_charm.description: A Lanternwright brass charm. Lyra swears it brings luck.

warden_core.name: Warden's Heartstone
warden_core.description: The still-warm crystal heart of the Hollow Warden. It pulses in time with the Elyndra Core.

toma_letter.name: Toma's Letter
toma_letter.description: A smudged letter with no address. Toma said not to read it. You haven't.
